The world

A synthetic Britain the supplier cannot see into: real prices and weather from 2016–25, and households drawn fresh each run with lives, homes and money the supplier is never told about. Each box below is one part of it, read from cause to effect.

Read each column top to bottom, from cause to what follows. Each box carries its state, read from the maturity map at publish: Live built and at target, Building under way, Planned not started.

Where to see it working

  • Capabilities — what the company can do with what crosses, each line with its test.
  • How it’s built — the rules that keep the world honest and the wall shut.
  • Explore — the drawn households and their bills, one at a time.
  • The code — the world’s modules, and the one seam the company reads through.
